anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive axonometric house-corner string-tensioning loom, live street-corridor BFS permeability solver, plucked Karplus-Strong cord acoustics, and exodus-dismantling ruin topology engine

stones.label: House-Corner Timber Supports
stones.source_phrase: the inhabitants stretch strings from the corners of the houses
stones.causal_role: 48 vertical timber corner-poles across 12 houses anchor every relational string; poles endure after walls and roofs are dismantled.

stones.label: Four Canonical Relational Cords (Blood, Trade, Authority, Agency)
stones.source_phrase: white or black or gray or black-and-white according to whether they mark a relationship of blood, of trade, authority, agency
stones.causal_role: Every stretched string carries exact Calvino coding: white (blood), black (trade), gray (authority), braided black-and-white (agency), each with distinct visual weave and plucked pitch.

stones.label: Impassable Street-Crossing Labyrinth
stones.source_phrase: When the strings become so numerous that you can no longer pass among them, the inhabitants leave
stones.causal_role: Live street-corridor pathfinding measures pedestrian permeability across N/S/E/W gates; crossing into 0 passable corridors triggers exodus.

stones.label: Dismantled Houses Leaving Only Strings and Supports
stones.source_phrase: the houses are dismantled; only the strings and their supports remain
stones.causal_role: Exodus reduces standingWalls=0, standingRoofs=0, remainingBones=0 while preserving 100% of corner poles and taut strings.

stones.label: Mountainside Refugee Overlook with Household Goods
stones.source_phrase: From a mountainside, camping with their household goods, Ersilia's refugees look at the labyrinth of taut strings and poles that rises in the plain
stones.causal_role: Refugees camp on the rocky mountainside with glowing fires and household bundles, overlooking the taut string-city below.

stones.label: Spider-Web Ruins Seeking a Form
stones.source_phrase: that spider-web of intricate relationships seeking a form
stones.causal_role: Without walls or bones, the leafless web of poles and vibrating strings IS still the city of Ersilia.

stones.label: Refounding Elsewhere: More Complex and More Regular
stones.source_phrase: They rebuild Ersilia elsewhere. They weave a similar figure of strings which they would like to be more complex and at the same time more regular than the other.
stones.causal_role: Refounding archives the abandoned plain ruin as ghost memory and seeds Generation g+1 with measurably higher complexityIndex AND higher regularityIndex.

inner_arch.premise: Inhabitants weave four-color strings between house corners to make invisible social bonds visible across the plain.
inner_arch.reversal: When relational density severs every street passage, masonry houses are discarded while the fragile strings remain standing.
inner_arch.revelation: The true substance of Ersilia was never stone walls or roofs—it is the pure taut graph of relationships seeking an ever more complex and more regular form across abandoned plains.
